title: Math Not Math
note: The case that pins the guard on single-dollar math (D21). A documentation repo is full of prices and shell variables, so `$...$` only counts when neither delimiter has whitespace just inside it and no digit follows the closing one; a candidate that fails is skipped rather than fatal, so "costs $5 and $10 more" finds no valid closer and stays text. Also here: escaped \$, dollars inside inline code and a fenced block, and delimiters that never close. Nothing in this file may come out as a formula.
